answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices leveraging zero-knowledge verifiable delay to lock adversarial staking collateral. Capital barrier analysis proves that whether an attacker deploys a dense grove, weaves a deceptive thread, or mimics a shifting dune, aggregate slashing penalties ensure a strictly negative expected payoff for Sybil multiplication. Thus, rational agents converge to a robust Nash equilibrium, since unilateral deviation guarantees suboptimal utility, cementing systemic Sybil resistance.
